sections.heading: PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
sections.text: PHP developer with around five years of experience building and maintaining production web applications, most of it in Laravel. My focus is the backend: modelling the domain with OOP, Clean Code, SOLID and DDD, designing REST APIs, and working with MySQL and PostgreSQL. I test with PHPUnit and Codeception (BDD / Gherkin), ship through Docker and GitLab CI/CD, and keep an eye on performance and security. I like understanding a system end to end and continuing to improve it once it works, rather than stopping at the first version that runs.

items.title: PHP / Laravel Developer
bullets: Designed and built the backend of a greenfield restaurant point-of-sale (POS) system in PHP with Laravel and PostgreSQL, structuring the domain with a layered architecture and DDD concepts.
Designed and consumed REST APIs; frontend in TypeScript and Alpine.js on top of the Laravel backend.
Wrote automated tests with Codeception and PHPUnit following a BDD approach; specified features with Gherkin together with management and the Product Owner.
Maintained GitLab CI/CD pipelines and Docker-based development and deployment environments.
Applied Clean Code, SOLID and design patterns; used AI tools for code analysis, generation and refactoring in daily work.

items.title: PHP Developer (Application Development)
bullets: Independently planned, implemented and maintained custom PHP web applications (ticketing systems, websites, marketing tools) for small and mid-sized clients.
Translated client requirements into software: wrote user stories with the team and clients, conceived requirements-appropriate solutions, and reviewed and approved programming work.
Designed, set up and optimized the underlying database systems.
Wrote automated tests with PHPUnit and documented code with PHPDoc.
Coordinated projects and handed programming tasks to the team; used AI tools to support analysis, design and code generation.

items.title: PHP Developer / Project Coordination
bullets: Took over a large, historically grown PHP codebase in a proprietary framework and continued developing it while preserving the existing architecture.
Analyzed complex legacy dependencies without existing documentation; debugged and extended the system safely.
Documented technical processes and coordinated a ten-person team.

items.title: Laravel Pivot Events (Open Source)
bullets: Open-source Laravel package that fires events for pivot (many-to-many) table changes with custom IDs, filling a gap in Laravel's default Eloquent behavior.
Required working with Laravel's Eloquent internals and event system; distributed via Composer.

items.degree: IT Specialist for Application Development (Fachinformatikerin fur Anwendungsentwicklung)
items.detail: wpt-online Domainmarketing UG, Gelsenkirchen  ·  Aug 2019 - Jun 2021. Apprenticeship completed; top-grade employment reference.
